履修条件
It is aimed to provide a broad knowledge of nanofabrication and nanogrowth for students in different fields. The lecture is given in a handy way to discuss each topic among students. However, it is also provided with the background of the physical or chemical principles, which can help to understand the phenomena and give insights to apply for other capabilities.
授業概要
日々進展しているナノテクノロジについて、材料成長技術、様々な材料加工方法、そしてそれを活用したデバイスについて説明を行います。講義資料も講義も英語で進めます。
Rapidly developing nanotechnology gives us the broad fundamental technology to grow materials layer by layer and to fabricate structures in nano-scale. This lecture surveys the current state of the art on nanotechnology and give the idea how to apply for your purposes. Especially, the details of atomic layer deposition (ALD) technique is given from the fundamental chemistry and physics to various applications. The lecture is not only for giving knowledge but also having discussion for various topics in order to deepen your thought.
